claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos show closed blue plastic drums with bung holes, but no labels, interior, or history confirms food-grade status or suitability for all liquids.

risks.risk: Capacity or volume in litres is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up of embossed or printed capacity on the drum, or a measuring tape beside a drum

risks.risk: Drums may be used rather than new
risks.proof: Close-up of drum surface showing wear, scratches, fading, or manufacturing date

risks.risk: Leaks, cracks, or damage may be present
risks.proof: Video of a drum being rolled and inspected at seams, closed ends, and bung holes

risks.risk: Lids and bungs may not be included
risks.proof: Shot showing bungs or caps fitted in the holes, or included with the drums
risks.if_unproven: as drum only without lids or bungs

risks.risk: Previous contents or food-grade status is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up of any label or embossing indicating food-grade status, or seller statement of prior contents
risks.if_unproven: as non-food-grade or unknown previous contents

risks.proof: Photo or video of the drum interior through an open bung

proof_requests: Close-up of drum labels or embossed capacity markings
Video showing drum interior through an open bung
Close-up showing whether bungs and lids are fitted
Close-up of drum exterior for wear and manufacturing date
response.reason: The witness identifies blue plastic drums with bung holes, so a worst-case price is possible; claims about universal liquid suitability and internal condition remain unproven.
